Hi Tom / Julia —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We're excited to get Benicio set up as an approved Redwood vendor so procurement and finance can issue POs and pay on the cadence you expect. To keep the intake tight and avoid back-and-forth, can you please send the items below? If some items require time, let us know ETA.

Required for vendor profile & payment setup (please attach where possible):
- Legal entity full name (exactly as registered)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or foreign tax id)
- W-9 (completed, signed PDF) or applicable tax form for non-US entities
- Remit-to address (street, city, state, zip) and billing address if different
- Invoice email(s) and PO reference format (how your invoices should reference our POs)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (preferred), wire transfer, or credit card; include ACH routing/account or wire details
- Bank letter or voided check for ACH verification (if available)
- Primary commercial contact for PO questions + phone
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) if applicable for the engagement
- Any vendor questionnaire or vendor onboarding form Benicio requires from customers

Procurement / PO items we need to confirm from our side:
- Desired payment terms (Net30/Net45/other)
- Any invoice consolidation preference (one invoice per PO / monthly statement)
- Whether you require any special invoice language for tax/exemption purposes

If it's helpful, we're happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the form together. Once we have the W-9 + bank details we can provision a vendor record and issue a test PO to validate remittance.

Thanks — target timeline on our side is to have vendor provisioned within 5 business days after receiving documents.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
